minutes.headline: Committee approved facility use fees and a retail-only concession stand model; retirees were honored.
minutes.summary: The meeting opened with recognition of retiring school employees. The committee approved line item transfers, minutes, an out-of-state Best Buddies trip, extended day handbooks, facility use fees, a retail concession stand concept, summer athletic programs, and three policies on third reading. A workshop date could not be set.

what_happened.line: The committee accepted a facilities fees proposal; the vote was not audible in the captions.
The committee approved a retail-only concept for the concession stand, which had the lowest one-time cost of the options discussed.
The committee accepted both summer athletics proposals, including summer league basketball with a per-team fee.
The committee approved line item transfers to cover negative accounts, including unemployment and substitutes.
The committee approved four policies on third reading; a workshop date was not set.

why_it_matters: Facility use fees, the concession stand model and summer team fees decide what local youth groups and families pay to use school facilities and programs, and whether those activities cover their own costs.
The line item transfers show which accounts ran short during the year, such as unemployment and substitutes, which shapes how future budgets for those lines are set.
